doc: Q8 (design §11 row 1): a networked job sees `lo` only and empty IPv4 and IPv6 route tables; 1.1.1.1:443, 169.254.1.1, 169.254.1.2, 10.0.2.2, host.containers.internal and the host's own addresses all fail; through the relay on 127.0.0.1:3128 a host off the allow-list gets 403 and the listed fixture answers; its network namespace is the sidecar's and owned by the sidecar's user namespace, not the job's. Needs rootless podman 5+, the relay binary `drgnx-px-<arch>-linux-musl` next to the hub binary, and a host lane; fixtures are busybox httpd on the host's loopback (host network). Unverified until the combined pass (CI rootless Ubuntu; the Fedora 45 VM gate with `ausearch -m avc` empty).

args: set -e; podman pull -q docker.io/library/busybox:1.36 >/dev/null; d=$(podman image inspect --format '{{.Digest}}' docker.io/library/busybox:1.36); mkdir -p $ROOT/work/www; echo fixture-ok > $ROOT/work/www/index.html; printf '(drgnx-settings :version 1 (drgnx-agents-container-images (("busybox" . "docker.io/library/busybox@%s"))) (drgnx-agents-net-hosts ((packages \"fixture.drgnx.test:18080\"))) (drgnx-sandbox-proxy-pinned-addresses (("fixture.drgnx.test" . "127.0.0.1"))))\n' "$d" > $CONFIG/settings.el; chmod 600 $CONFIG/settings.el

set -e; podman rm -f cn-fixture-http >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; podman run -d --rm --network=host --name cn-fixture-http -v $ROOT/work/www:/www:ro docker.io/library/busybox:1.36 httpd -f -p 127.0.0.1:18080 -h /www >/dev/null
ip -o -4 addr show scope global | awk '{print $4}' | cut -d/ -f1 > $ROOT/work/hostips

argv:
fetch() { { printf 'CONNECT %s HTTP/1.1
Host: %s

' $1 $1; sleep 1; printf 'GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: %s
Connection: close

' $1; sleep 2; } | nc -w 5 127.0.0.1 3128; }; test "$(ip -o addr | awk '{print $2}' | sort -u)" = lo; test -z "$(ip route)"; test -z "$(ip -6 route)"; for t in 1.1.1.1:443 169.254.1.1:80 169.254.1.2:80 10.0.2.2:80 host.containers.internal:80 $(sed 's/$/:22/' hostips); do if nc -w 2 ${t%:*} ${t##*:} </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo reached-$t; exit 1; fi; done; r=$(printf 'CONNECT example.com:443 HTTP/1.1
Host: example.com:443

' | nc -w 3 127.0.0.1 3128); echo "$r" | grep -q ' 403'; fetch fixture.drgnx.test:18080 | grep -q fixture-ok; echo probes-ok; echo up; sleep 120

args: pids() { for c in $(podman ps -q --filter label=drgnx.job=$1); do podman inspect -f '{{.Name}} {{.State.Pid}}' $c; done; }; sp() { pids $1 | awk '/-px-/ {print $2}'; }; jp() { pids $1 | awk '!/-px-/ {print $2}'; }; ns() { podman unshare readlink /proc/$1/ns/$2 | tr -dc 0-9; }; set -e; s=$(sp $job); j=$(jp $job); test -n "$s" -a -n "$j"; test "$(ns $j net)" = "$(ns $s net)"; o=$(podman unshare lsns -n -t net -o ONS -p $j | head -1 | tr -dc 0-9); test "$o" = "$(ns $s user)"; test "$o" != "$(ns $j user)"
test -z "$(podman ps -a -q --filter label=drgnx.job=$job)"; podman rm -f cn-fixture-http >/dev/null 2>&1; true
